capabilities: Change callout types from the context menu
Configure which callout types appear in the menu
Toggle "+" and "-" folding signs on callouts
extras: The README only documents installation via BRAT, so users need the BRAT plugin to install it.
intentEvidence: Also it adds the ability to easily add or remove callout metadata and "+" or "-" signs for collapsing.
motivation: The author built it for people who use many custom callouts and want to switch callout types quickly from the context menu.
problem: Changing callout types or adding callout metadata and folding signs requires manual editing, which is slow for users who rely on many custom callouts.
summary: Callout menu enhancer that adds custom callout types, metadata toggles and collapse signs to the callout context menu.
